chose: The lan web's phone list says when each phone was last used as "Used <day> or later": the day its sign-in last renewed, which home keeps (C493), and the latest day that can be known for sure. Each row also says the day it paired, or that home didn't keep it.
options: "Used <day> or later", from the day its sign-in last renewed
no time of use at all
gray: Home keeps no last-seen time, only when a phone's sign-in last started or slid (C493), which can be up to half a term behind its last use. "Last seen" would claim more than home knows, and "renewed" names the machinery the screen is not to show; saying the day as a lower bound is true and in the person's terms.
